private-state-distinct.assertion: Two same-kind actors maintain distinct mutable private state.

foreign-state-denied.assertion: A foreign actor cannot read or mutate another actor's private state.

loan-conflict-denied.assertion: An actor's live read loan excludes a conflicting local write.

independent-peer-progress.assertion: The peer actor progresses while a different actor retains a loan or awaits.

reclaim-peer-survives.assertion: Physical reclamation of A cannot affect live B; host inspection is mandatory.

stale-handle-denied.assertion: A stale actor/region handle fails after reclamation and incarnation change.

continuation-resumes-once.assertion: Repeated wakes, cancellation and stale events never reenter a completed or upgraded turn.

supervisor-control-once.assertion: An actor panic emits one authenticated CONTROL notice and is never caught by guest actor code.

upgrade-rollback-safe.assertion: State migration, publication and rollback do not double-deliver, lose ownership or admit stale generation events.

http-endpoint-owned.assertion: One HTTP endpoint has exactly one guest owner until its terminal transition.

network-backpressure.assertion: A full ingress/egress queue enforces bounded admission, cancel/deadline propagation, and no carrier-blocking I/O.

network-upgrade.assertion: Requests in flight obey generation routing and cleanly drain or roll back during upgrade.

cross-tenant-effects-denied.assertion: Untrusted tenant code cannot access another tenant's network, filesystem, process or credentials.

tenant-recycle-scrubs.assertion: A worker cannot expose prior tenant heap bytes or authority after reuse.

hostile-tenant-contained.assertion: Hostile untrusted tenant crash, panic, timeout or resource abuse is contained by a verified per-tenant TenantVM/isolate boundary inside the shared OS process, without damaging another tenant. A separate OS process is an optional stronger deployment profile, not a universal requirement.

bounded-scheduling.assertion: Execution and scheduling budgets have an independently analyzed finite upper bound.

overload-rejected.assertion: Real-time admission rejects infeasible reservations before dispatch.

deadline-under-load.assertion: Target hardware executes admitted workload within documented deadlines under the test envelope.
